svg.aria-label: How CodeOrbit works. 1: You add skills, study sessions, projects and goals. 2: CodeOrbit turns them into streaks, a score, charts and badges. 3: Everything is saved in your own browser. No server, no account. Clearing browser data deletes it, so export a backup in Settings.

path.title: Your data never leaves your browser.
Clearing your browser data deletes it.
Back up anytime: Settings → Export JSON Backup.
